name: option-test-1b0c555df9/repeated_option_equals-p.bal
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Function definition — Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature

## Invocations / ### Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature.
reason: The included record parameter and record type are supported syntax, but the asserted behavior is a panic when command-line parsing encounters repeated --stringVal=value options. Subset 10 does not cover command-line option binding or duplicate-option rejection; its function-call argument support does not establish this entry-point runtime behavior.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line option parsing and rejection of repeated scalar options for main's included record parameter
test_design_notes: The @args directive supplies two stringVal options and @panic asserts rejection before the empty main body executes.
